environment.note: All checks run locally with synthetic fixtures only; no user source database, live session or credential is read by the suite. Linux coverage is owned by CI.

skip_reasons: test_scan_no_symlink_traversal: creating symlinks is unavailable in this environment.
test_restricted_secret_permissions: POSIX file-mode assertion; Windows uses account ACLs.

frontend_strict_check.details: eslint, strict typecheck (tsc), prettier format:check, i18n check (en 454 keys = pl 454 keys), reproducible esbuild bundle of index.html/app.js/style.css

browser_checks.target: production dist served by the real observer with manifest verification
browser_checks.coverage: desktop and mobile; navigation, graph, inspector, timeline pagination, settings persistence, integrations, error states, structured completeness notices, usage report periods/toggles/consistency/exports, English and Polish (default English)

mcp_checks.coverage: protocol negotiation, stable read tools with conditional report_event, strict validation, resources, limits, coverage consistency, token privilege boundaries, no secrets in responses or logs, stdio bridge clean from a foreign working directory with a spaced state path

migration_checks.coverage: fresh install, v5 state migrated with backup and preserved rows/settings/assessments/secrets, current V6 untouched, repeated open idempotent, interrupted and write-error rollback with retry, newer schema refused, CLI migrate and running-observer refusal

run_1m.loaded_sessions_detail_window: 148 of 1000; aggregates stay complete, limited details are reported explicitly

synthetic_benchmark.restart_after_full_import: identical totals for both sizes; 12,347,213 and 126,001,216 unchanged
synthetic_benchmark.memory_method: tracemalloc peak = Python allocations in bytes; Windows working set via GetProcessMemoryInfo (null when unavailable). tracemalloc is not process RSS.
synthetic_benchmark.baseline_comparison: Etap C reported 9.5 s / 1 cycle (100k) and 103.6 s / 6 cycles (1M). This run measured 10.56 s / 1 cycle and 126.95 s / 7 cycles with exact sums and lossless restarts; the difference is consistent with added coverage bookkeeping and machine load and is reported as this run's real measurement.

ci.status: green for the final V6 commit (matrix windows-latest and ubuntu-latest with Python 3.10 and 3.14; browser job on Node 22 on both systems with mandatory browser tests on the production dist)
ci.browser_evidence: synthetic only (playwright-report and test-results; .fixture-info.json is never uploaded)

limitations: The test suite never reads the user's OpenCode database, Codex logs or live sessions; only synthetic fixtures are used.
No real ChatGPT or Codex client login was performed; connecting a real client is an external acceptance step (checklist in the Integrations screen and docs/V6_HANDOFF.md).
Linux behaviour is covered by CI, not by the local Windows run.
The single-owner OAuth server is a local implementation and has not been independently audited.
Synthetic benchmark numbers vary with machine load; expected sums come from the generator, never from a recorded result.
At 1M events only 148 of 1000 sessions have full details inside the bounded window while the usage aggregates remain complete; this is reported explicitly in coverage, not hidden.
